_comment: ⚙️ The read corpus. Every query is executed against the shared repository records; the result is the `data` payload the executor returns, rendered as canonical JSON. Nothing here uses a field whose value the reference oracle cannot decide independently.

queries.source: { repo { id name path } }
{ repo { __typename id } }
{ here: repo { name } there: repo { path } }
{ technologies { id name root kind uri } }
{ technologies(filter: { filter: "repo" }) { name } }
{ bundles { id name root sourceRoot projectType tags kind uri } }
{ bundles { name packages { name version path kind } } }
{ bundles { name folders { id } files { id } breachs { id } } }
{ folders { id path uri name kind ignored generated parent { id } bundle { id } } }
{ folder(path: "repo") { name children { name kind } files { name } } }
{ files { id path uri name extension kind ignored generated content } }
{ file(path: "repo/rust/lib.rs") { name sections { id name path range { start end } } } }
{ file(path: "repo/rust/lib.rs") { definitions { id name kind range { start end } } } }
{ sections { id name path range { start end } file { path name } } }
{ sections { name children { __typename id name range { start end } } } }
{ definitions { id name kind section { name path } file { path } } }
{ contributors { id github name names email emails fingerprint fingerprints links { name url } icons { avatar } } }
{ contributor(id: "usalu") { id name } }
{ contributor(id: "nobody") { id github name } }
{ repo { checkpoints { id sha title date } } }
{ repo { checkpoints(limit: 1) { sha } } }
{ repo { goals { id title description prompt dueDate createdAt client llm effort status milestone issue parent interactions { kind } } } }
{ tickets { id year month day slug path uri title emoji prompt summary status llm effort client checkpoint goal parent } }
{ tickets(year: 2026) { slug } }
{ tickets(status: CLOSED) { slug status } }
{ tickets(year: 2026, month: 9, day: 5) { slug } }
{ tickets { slug dates { started finished } } }
{ tickets { slug interactions { kind prompt checkpoint llm effort date system client author } } }
{ ticket(year: 2026, month: 9, day: 6, slug: "PORT-EXECUTOR") { slug author { id github name } } }
{ ticket(year: 1999, month: 1, day: 1, slug: "NOPE") { slug } }
{ todos { id name description parentId location { filePath line column } } }
{ todos(filter: { filter: "docs" }) { name } }
{ drafts { id } }
{ interactions { kind prompt checkpoint author sourceKind sourceId goalId ticketId llm effort date system client } }
{ policies { id name description scopes groups { name description scopes kinds { id priority } } statutes { id priority autofixable reason solution } } }
{ policy(id: "repo/docs") { id name scopes } }
{ policy(id: "nope") { id name scopes } }
{ statutes { id priority autofixable reason solution } }
{ statute(id: "docs/readme/missing") { id priority reason } }
{ statute(id: "made/up/kind") { id priority reason solution autofixable } }
{ statutes { id policy { id name scopes } } }
{ breachs { id kindId scope line column excerpt summary priority autofixable } }
{ breachs { id kind { id priority autofixable reason solution } } }
{ breachs(scope: "repo/go") { id scope } }
{ analyze { metrics { total autofixable byPriority { high medium low } } breachs { id priority } } }
{ repo { bundles { name } folders { name } files { name } sections { name } definitions { name } contributors { github } statutes { id } } }
{ repo { tickets(status: OPEN) { slug status } } }
{ repo { breachs(scope: "repo/rust") { id } } }
query Tickets($year: Int, $status: TicketStatus) { tickets(year: $year, status: $status) { slug status } }
{ open: tickets(status: OPEN) { key: slug } closed: tickets(status: CLOSED) { key: slug } }
